title: ui: flow designer leaves a typed schedule block with no cadence when the cron is cleared, which the flow parse now refuses
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5mw7HFYn9o4LEGMQdK

## Defect

`scheduleWithExpression` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts`, near line 1710) rewrites the whole start-node `config.schedule` block on each cron edit. When the author clears the cron on a typed block, it leaves `{ type: 'cron' }` or `{ type: 'cron', timezone: 'UTC' }`. Only an untyped `{ expression }` collapses to `undefined`. The field's own help text says "A time-relative sweep defaults to daily if left empty".

- **On main today:** the draft stores, and the schedule flow silently never binds. A sweep falls back to daily 08:00 UTC.
- **Once PR #31376 lands (#31224 item B1):** `FlowSchema` judges a typed `config.schedule` against the published `ScheduleSchema`. The draft save is refused 422 at `nodes.i.config.schedule`. The refusal names the cure, but the designer produced the shape.

## Expected

When a typed block no longer carries its cadence (`expression`, `intervalMs` or `at`), the designer drops `config.schedule` entirely, as it already does for the untyped form. It never writes a typed block with no cadence.

## Evidence

Contract review 6717630512 on PR #31376, ③ ("the Studio designer produces a refused draft"). Seat ruling 6717636410 on #31224, item 4.

Refs #31224
